|strategy=By Joe Alread<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/endor/dark/small/sneakattack.html</ref>

Biker Scouts tend to bunch up at sites when the time calls for it, and if they're all by themselves with nobody else, playing this card can cause your total battle destiny to skyrocket, thus killing that pesky Jedi or whatever else might be around. The limit you an get is +6, but who's complaining? Even with three scouts together, all you need at that point is a two to kill Ben, not a hard task at all.
